title: First Steps
brief:
Welcome to the platformer! Your character is bound by gravity. Each call moves you one tile:

  • left(), right() — walk one tile in that direction.
  • jump_up(), jump_left(), jump_right() — jump (one tile up, optionally one tile sideways). Only works when you're standing on a surface or against a wall — except for a double-jump while still in the air.

For now, just walk over to the flag.
